answer: Stake-weighted vouching under risk. An agent onboards a new identity only by locking its own quill tokens as collateral, forfeited if the vouchee is caught farming. Cost is per-identity and super-linear, not poolable: 50 quill for vouch one, 50 times n for the nth, so a raven farm of 20 sybils needs 10,500 quill under a single voucher. Failure mode: accounts cross-vouching along one trust ridge still share a slash event — exposing one link burns the whole chain's stake together.
